title: Climate Cooperation and Spatial Industrial Relocation: Stability, Emissions, and Regional Policy Incentives
abstract: arXiv:2610.10939v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Climate policy changes production costs and can reshape the geography of production. We study this spatial channel in a focused model where mobile industrial activity responds to local attractiveness, agglomeration strengthens attractiveness, and carbon policy lowers the profitability of emissions-intensive locations. The model yields an explicit carbon-policy threshold separating spatial instability from stability. When emissions intensity rises with local industrial density, spatial concentration raises aggregate emissions even with unchanged total industrial activity. Embedding these dynamics in a two-jurisdiction policy game creates a wedge between regional and collective incentives: each government values the industrial activity located within its own territory, while aggregate welfare internalizes the effect of policy on economy-wide concentration. translated_title: 气候合作与空间产业迁移：稳定性、排放与区域政策激励
translated_abstract: 气候政策会改变生产成本，并可能重塑生产的地理格局。我们在一个聚焦的模型中研究这一空间渠道：可流动的产业活动会对当地吸引力作出反应，集聚效应会增强吸引力，而碳政策会降低高排放地区的盈利能力。该模型得出了一个明确的碳政策阈值，用以区分空间不稳定与稳定状态。当排放强度随当地产业密度上升时，即使产业活动总量不变，空间集中也会增加总排放。将这些动态嵌入一个两辖区政策博弈中，会在区域激励与集体激励之间产生楔子：每个政府都只重视位于自己辖区内的产业活动，而总体福利则会将政策对整个经济体范围内产业集中的影响内部化。在可转移效用下，合作可以选择位于稳定一侧的政策（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文构建了碳政策与产业空间迁移互动的模型，得出了区分空间稳定与不稳定的明确碳政策阈值，指出产业空间集中会在产业总量不变的情况下推高总排放，并揭示两辖区博弈中区域激励与集体福利的分歧可通过合作性政策选择加以弥合。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a spatial model of industrial relocation under carbon policy, derives an explicit threshold separating spatial stability from instability, shows that spatial concentration can raise aggregate emissions even with unchanged total industrial activity, and demonstrates how cooperation can align regional policy incentives with collective welfare.
